objective_value: <float> Total expected cost represented by the complete submitted two-stage witness.
model_variables: <dict, key: canonical variable name> Sparse complete witness; omitted variables are zero. Keys use underscore syntax exactly as specified by model_variable_name_patterns.
y: <dict, key: '{period}'> Whether production is set up at the plant in each period (1 = yes, 0 = no).
z: <dict, key: '{node}_{vehicle}_{period}'> Whether a node is visited by a vehicle in a given period (1 = yes), where node 0 indicates the vehicle is dispatched from the plant.
x: <dict, key: '{node_i}_{node_j}_{vehicle}_{period}'> Number of times the edge between two nodes is traversed by a vehicle in a given period (1 for customer-customer edges, up to 2 for plant-customer edges).

model_variable_name_patterns.z_{i}_{k}_{t}: visit node i by vehicle k in period t
